'''Nozabuiba''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was a social items vendor located in the [[Siltshift cantina|Siltshift Cantina]] in [[Mos Ila]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. His stock included [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] clothing and an [[Orlean]] [[Rebel (speeder bike)|Rebel]] speeder.<ref name="TOR" />
